(Retrieved via WebFetch; condensed by fetch tool)

US Refuelling Aircraft to Israel: The US notified Israel of sending dozens of additional refuelling aircraft ahead of potential escalated strikes against Iran. Currently 33 KC-46A tankers are parked at Ben Gurion Airport. Reports indicate 5-8 planes per day may arrive. Transportation Minister Miri Regev had announced reducing the number to 20.

Iranian Responses:
An Iranian Revolutionary Guards commander vowed: "effective and targeted strikes from across Iran against the enemy will continue" until US strikes on Iran's southern coastline ceased.
Mohsen Rezaei, an adviser to Iran's supreme leader: "If US strikes continue for several more days, we will move into a phase of full-scale offensive operations."

US Military Actions: The US military confirmed destroying Iran's Chabahar port surveillance tower, stating it "degrades IRGC's ability to coordinate attacks on innocent civilian crew members."

Kuwait reported Iranian drone attacks wounded several military personnel at army facilities.

No direct Netanyahu or Katz statements on Iran on this date in the retrieved entries; no detailed updates on US-Iran diplomatic talks.
